_about: The surveyed ground and the aerial photograph of each range, fetched by scripts/terrain/fetch.mjs on GitHub's runner (the Terrain workflow) from two US government services, public domain. Each file is named with its content hash and served under /terrain/ with a one-year cache header. Heights are 16-bit PNGs: metres above sea level = pixel × stepM + offsetM, the top-left pixel's centre at (originE + spacingM/2, originN − spacingM/2) in NAD83 / UTM zone 11N (EPSG 26911), rows running south. The photograph covers the same square as the near heights. Every figure here is a reading of the service's own answer on the date given.
